title: Rationale design and synthesis of new quinazoline derivatives as DNA intercalators and topoisomerase II inhibitors.
authors: Helmy, Amr; Mohamed, Mamdouh F A; Eissa, Ibrahim H; Mahdy, Hazem A
one_liner_zh: 该文设计合成喹唑啉衍生物作为DNA嵌入剂和拓扑异构酶II抑制剂，虽涉及DNA结合和分子对接，但核心是药物化学与抗癌活性，非TF-DNA互作机制研究，方法上仅简单对接，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: In pursuit of novel anticancer agents with enhanced potency and selectivity, a new series of quinazoline-based derivatives was rationally designed, synthesized, and biologically evaluated as potential DNA intercalators and topoisomerase II (Topo II) inhibitors. Building upon a previously identified lead compound (6), structural modifications were introduced to reinforce key pharmacophoric features essential for DNA intercalation and enzyme inhibition. Two distinct series of compounds were developed, incorporating either N-phenylacetamide (VII-series) or N-(4-cinnamoylphenyl)acetamide (VIII-series) side chains to target DNA grooves. In vitro cytotoxicity assays against HepG-2 and MCF-7 cancer cell lines revealed that several compounds, particularly VIIIe, exhibited potent anti-proliferative activity slightly less than that of the reference drug doxorubicin. It showed favorable selectivity indices over normal WI-38 fibroblasts. Further biological evaluation showed that compound VIIIe effectively inhibited Topo II (IC(5)(0) = 11.71 nM) and demonstrated strong DNA-binding affinity (IC(5)(0) = 14.50 muM), outperforming doxorubicin in both assays. Apoptosis-related protein analysis in MCF-7 cells revealed a significant increase in Bax expression and suppression of Bcl-2, indicating activation of mitochondrial-mediated apoptotic pathways. Molecular docking studies supported these findings, showing that VIIIe achieved a high binding affinity within the Topo II-DNA complex through multiple stabilizing interactions. Collectively, these results underscore the therapeutic potential of VIIIe and its analogs as promising lead candidates for the development of selective, DNA-targeted anticancer agents.
abstract_zh: 为了寻求具有更强效力和选择性的新型抗癌药物，合理设计、合成并生物学评价了一系列基于喹唑啉的衍生物，作为潜在的DNA嵌入剂和拓扑异构酶II（Topo II）抑制剂。在先前鉴定的先导化合物（6）基础上，引入结构修饰以增强对DNA嵌入和酶抑制至关重要的关键药效团特征。开发了两个不同的化合物系列，分别引入N-苯乙酰胺（VII系列）或N-(4-肉桂酰苯基)乙酰胺（VIII系列）侧链以靶向DNA沟槽。针对HepG-2和MCF-7癌细胞系的体外细胞毒性测定显示，几种化合物，尤其是VIIIe，表现出强效的抗增殖活性，略低于参考药物多柔比星。它对正常WI-38成纤维细胞显示出有利的选择性指数。进一步的生物学评价表明，化合物VIIIe有效抑制Topo II（IC(5)(0) = 11.71 nM）并表现出强DNA结合亲和力（IC(5)(0) = 14.50 μM），在两项测定中均优于多柔比星。MCF-7细胞中的凋亡相关蛋白分析显示Bax表达显著增加和Bcl-2抑制，表明线粒体介导的凋亡通路被激活。分子对接研究支持这些发现，显示VIIIe通过多种稳定相互作用在Topo II-DNA复合物中实现高结合亲和力。总体而言，这些结果强调了VIIIe及其类似物作为开发选择性、DNA靶向抗癌药物的有前景先导候选物的治疗潜力。
